name: Ecem Öztürk
bio: Ecem Öztürk is an art director and designer based in Toronto. Her practice moves between brand identity, editorial direction and immersive 3D. Her interests circle tactility, objects and memory in a tech-infused world. She is very comfortable with AI, even builds her own design tools with it.
